svg.title: CodeBuild produces a checked artifact handoff
svg.desc: A selected source revision and buildspec enter a configured CodeBuild project. Ordered build phases run checks and create fresh output. The declared artifact file list and destination select what a later pipeline or S3 consumer receives. A failed check stops handoff. Cache, secrets, network access, role permissions and supporting cost are separate project concerns explained in the lesson; build success alone does not prove deployment or customer behavior.

g.text: A build passes a specific parcel forward
Check the input, the worker, the output and the handoff.
3 Run phases and check fresh output
5 Check what the next stage received
Record code, lockfile and buildspec.yml together.
Choose image, runtime, role, logs and timeout.
Install, pre-build and build; fail if checks fail.
The file list and output setting define the parcel.
Failed check: stop the handoff and keep its evidence.
Cache is a speed aid, not the released artifact.
A passing build does not prove deployment or customer behavior.
